cases.message: Estimate a historical Ames sale price for a single-family detached, one-story home in North Ames with low-density residential zoning and central air. It was built in 1960 and has quality 6 out of 10, 1,500 sq ft of above-ground living area, a 9,000 sq ft lot, 75 ft of street frontage, 1,000 sq ft of basement, 3 above-ground bedrooms, 2 above-ground full bathrooms, and a 2-car garage.
